### Market Context

- MAGMA outperformed BTC by 32.39% in the 24h period prior to the snapshot.

### Protocol Context

All missing lanes are treated as explicit unconfirmed gaps, not implicitly neutral or positive signals. Confidence in the profile is low until these coverage lanes become available for validation.

decision_report.analysis:
### Token Identity
Solana (SOL) is a layer-1 platform coin launched on March 16, 2020, currently ranked 7th by overall market capitalization. Its native SPL contract is deployed on the Solana mainnet, and the asset is tagged as a proof-of-stake platform, part of the Solana ecosystem, classified as a digital commodity in SEC/CFTC token taxonomies, and included in multiple notable venture and reserve portfolios.

### Market Context
The latest market snapshot reports SOL trading at $94.25 USD, with a circulating market capitalization of ~$55.61 billion and fully diluted valuation of ~$60.01 billion. 24h trading volume stands at ~$6.61 billion, equal to 11.89% of current market cap, indicating very high near-term liquidity. Recent price performance shows a 5.98% decline over the trailing 24 hours, a 9.11% drop over 7 days, and a 19.87% decline over the past 30 days, though the asset remains up 32.51% over the trailing 90 day window. SOL underperformed BTC by a marginal 0.61% over the last 24 hours.

### Protocol Context
Protocol matching confirms the asset maps directly to the core Solana layer-1 network. Reported 24h protocol fees total $564,523, while 24h protocol revenue is $38,828. Current total value locked and TVL trend metrics are not available in this coverage run. Recent public content includes near-term price support analysis around the $98 level, and an announcement that Polygon is expanding its Open Money Stack to add Solana support targeting $2 trillion in stablecoin volume.

### Coverage Gaps
Live holder coverage is currently unavailable, so no analysis of ownership concentration, distribution, or holder behavior can be included in this profile. Stable protocol-history deltas including historical TVL trends and longer-term protocol performance metrics are also unavailable, limiting the depth of fundamental trend analysis. No values have been inferred or fabricated to fill these gaps, and they remain explicitly marked as unresolved.
